title: FPIs put ₹1.12 lakh crore into India in just 30 days #Shorts
description: FPIs sold ₹70,704 crore in September and October combined. Then November happened — a record ₹1.12 lakh crore flowed back in just one month. Sensex surged +11% and BSE market cap added ₹34.6 lakh crore. Here's what triggered the massive reversal and what it means for Indian equity markets. Educational content only — not financial advice.
